name: Mamba2Fwd

x.description: 输入张量, shape (B, T, H, P); bfloat16/float16/float32

dt.description: 时间步 raw 值 (未加 bias/未激活), shape (B, T, H); 与 x 同 dtype

A.description: 状态衰减系数 (恒负, = -exp(A_log)), shape (H,); float32

B.description: SSM B 矩阵, shape (B, T, G, N), G=ngroups (GQA 组内共享); 与 x 同 dtype

C.description: SSM C 矩阵, shape (B, T, G, N); 与 x 同 dtype

D.description: 跳连系数, shape (H,) 或 (H, P); float32

z.description: 门控张量, shape (B, T, H, P); shape[0]==0 表示无 z (rmsnorm 路径)

dt_bias.description: dt 偏置 (恒负量级), shape (H,); float32

initial_states.description: 初始状态, shape (B, H, P, N) float32; shape[0]==0 表示无

chunk_size.description: kernel 分块大小, int 标量 (数学上与分块无关)

dt_softplus.description: 是否对 dt 施加 softplus, int 0/1

dt_limit_hi.description: dt 截断上界, float (1e38 代表 +inf)

out.description: 输出, shape (B, T, H, P), 与 x 同 dtype

final_states.description: 末状态, shape (B, H, P, N), 与 C 同 dtype

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def run(x, dt, A, B, C, D, z, dt_bias, initial_states,
        chunk_size, dt_softplus, dt_limit_lo, dt_limit_hi):
    device = x.device
    Bsz, T, H, P = x.shape
    G, N = B.shape[2], B.shape[3]
    R = H // G

    xf = x.float()
    Bh = B.float().repeat_interleave(R, dim=2)
    Ch = C.float().repeat_interleave(R, dim=2)

    dtr = dt.float() + dt_bias.float()
    if dt_softplus:
        dtr = F.softplus(dtr)
    dtr = dtr.clamp(dt_limit_lo, dt_limit_hi)
    a = (dtr * A.float()).exp()

    if initial_states.shape[0] > 0:
        S = initial_states.float().clone()
    else:
        S = torch.zeros(Bsz, H, P, N, device=device)
    ys = []
    for t in range(T):
        S = (a[:, t].unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1) * S
             + (dtr[:, t].unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1)
                * xf[:, t].unsqueeze(-1)) * Bh[:, t].unsqueeze(-2))
        ys.append((S * Ch[:, t].unsqueeze(-2)).sum(-1))
    y = torch.stack(ys, dim=1)

    if D.numel() > 0:
        Df = D.float()
        Dv = Df.view(1, 1, H, 1) if Df.dim() == 1 else Df.view(1, 1, H, P)
        y = y + xf * Dv
    if z.shape[0] > 0:
        y = y * F.silu(z.float())

    return y.to(x.dtype), S.to(C.dtype)
description:
Mamba-2 SSD chunk-scan 前向标杆。对标 state-spaces/mamba @ main 的 mamba_chunk_scan_combined (mamba_ssm/ops/triton/ssd_combined.py:628); 官方 torch 参考链: ssd_chunk_state.py chunk_state_ref + ssd_state_passing.py state_passing_ref + ssd_chunk_scan.py chunk_scan_ref。
数学定义 (逐 token, 对每个 batch b、头 h; GQA: 头 h 用组 g = h//(H/G) 的 B/C; 状态 S ∈ R^{P×N}, P=headdim, N=dstate):
  1) dt 预处理 (fp32): raw = dt + dt_bias; dt' = softplus(raw) (dt_softplus=1 时, threshold=20); dt' = clamp(dt', dt_limit_lo, dt_limit_hi); a = exp(dt' * A) (A 恒负)
  2) SSD 状态递推: S_0 = initial_states (缺省为 0); S_t = a_t * S_{t-1} + dt'_t * (x_t ⊗ B_t); y_t = S_t · C_t + D ⊙ x_t; out_t = y_t (z 缺省) 或 y_t * silu(z_t) (z 存在时, 门控在 D 残差之后)
输入约束: A = -exp(A_log) 恒负, 生成范围 uniform(-16, -1) (对应 HF/fla 初始化 A_log ∈ (0, ln16)); dt_bias 生成范围 uniform(-5, -1) (inv_softplus(U(0.001,0.1)) 量级)。
输出 final_states 回铸 C.dtype (kernel _state_passing_fwd 以 out_dtype=C.dtype 返回末态)。
